summary: Iteration 11 validated tier auto-update and offline-link Auto-Fix through the public deployment. Backend regression passed 45/45 tests. POST /api/admin/hosts/refresh-tiers returned successful VOE and FireStream results; GET /api/hosts persisted VOE Tier 1 at $45 for AU/GB/US, FireStream Tier 1 at $40 for AU/DE/US/GB, and timestamps. DoodStream Auto-Fix replaced the bogus URL and persisted online status; FireStream returned the required 400; non-owner access returned 403. Frontend admin tier refresh and both Offline-Streams button states/click flows passed. Temporary mirrors were deleted.

minor.issue: Code review: replacement selection does not always enforce ONLINE status. DoodStream falls back to any exact title match when no canplay match exists, while VOE does not filter match status at all; the endpoint then unconditionally stores status='online'. This can falsely repair a link to another offline file outside the known-online fixture tested.

action_items: Filter DoodStream and VOE replacement candidates to provider-confirmed online/playable files only; if none are online, return ok:false rather than setting an offline candidate to online.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1171 lines, above the 700-line review threshold; split integrations, auth, hosts, mirrors, settings, and background jobs into focused modules.

find_replacement violates its own newest-ONLINE contract: DoodStream uses `online or exact`, VOE performs no online-status filter, and autofix_link then force-labels the selected file online without provider verification.

The tier refresh UI always emits toast.success, including when every result has ok=false (for example, `0 Anbieter-Tiers aktualisiert`); use an error/warning state when zero providers refresh successfully and distinguish partial success.

success_rate.backend: 100% (45/45 executed API regression tests passed; one unexercised online-candidate edge found by code review)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (requested admin refresh and Offline-Streams Auto-Fix flows passed)

seed_data_creation: Created isolated DoodStream and FireStream mirrors for backend and UI tests; every created mirror was deleted and deletion was verified. Full regression registered temporary TEST_ normal-user accounts via the existing fixture; no user-delete API exists. Tier refresh intentionally persisted current public tiers and tiers_updated_at timestamps.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 11 added TestTierRefreshAndAutoFix to backend_test.py and made older geo-rate assertions dynamic because tier auto-update intentionally changes public rates. UI selectors verified: refresh-tiers-button, offline-mirror-{id}, and autofix-{mirrorId}-{hostId}. Dood success toast text was 'Link automatisch ersetzt'; FireStream disabled title was 'Auto-Fix für diesen Hoster nicht verfügbar (keine Datei-Listen-API)'. The first UI run failed only because the test expected the word 'unterstützt'; the corrected rerun passed and both runs cleaned their own fixtures.
rca_of_the_issue: find_replacement treats title equality as sufficient after an online filter misses: DoodStream explicitly falls back from `online` to `exact`, and VOE sorts all exact matches without checking provider status. autofix_link trusts that result and writes status='online'. Remove the fallback and validate VOE candidate status (or call provider file-info) before persisting.
